en.title: New here? A note from Peter — and how to get started
en.body:
Hello, and thank you for visiting.
I'm Peter Lee, a CPA licensed in Korea and the US. I personally handle every engagement here. 😊

I'd like to share a little about how I work with clients.

"Is it okay to reach out on a weekend?"
"I can only talk after hours in our HQ time zone — is that a problem?"
My answer is always the same: "Whenever it suits you."

If I'm in a meeting or on an audit site, I may not reply right away. But I check every message as soon as I can, and I'll at least point you in the right direction first, so you're not left waiting.

Questions about Korea usually come with a deadline — a filing due date, a month-end package for HQ, or a handover from a previous finance lead. Having spent five years on the subsidiary side reporting to a headquarters, I know how long a day of waiting can feel. That's why I treat fast feedback as part of the service.

Not sure where to start? These four things are enough for a first conversation:
① A short overview of your Korean entity (industry, year set up, rough headcount)
② What's on your mind
③ Any deadline you're working toward
④ Your latest financial statements (fine to send later)

You can write to me through the Google Form (1 minute, a nickname is fine), or message me on KakaoTalk or LINE. There's no need to name your company at first.

I'll explain where things stand, what to check, and what comes next, in plain English. Nothing makes me happier than hearing "Now I know how this works" at the end of a call.

I believe accounting and tax work starts with trust between people. So rather than just handing over results, I share progress along the way and keep the door open for questions at any time.

Even a quick question is welcome.
Weekdays or weekends, I'll get back to you as quickly as I can.

Have a great day,
Peter

en.title: October Korea tax calendar (VAT preliminary return due Oct 26)
en.body:
Key deadlines this month (some dates move later because of holidays):

・Oct 12 (Mon) Withholding tax (incl. local income tax) and resident tax (employee portion) for September — file & pay
・Oct 12 (Mon) Social insurance premiums for September (pension, health, employment, industrial accident)
・Oct 15 (Thu) Daily-worker employment insurance report for September
・Oct 26 (Mon) VAT 2nd-period preliminary return & payment (Jul–Sep)
・Nov 2 (Mon) Simplified payment statements for September (daily-worker, business and other income)

■ VAT preliminary return
・Corporations with Jan–Jun 2026 supply value of KRW 150 million or more → file and pay by Oct 26
・Below KRW 150 million → the tax office issues a notice for 50% of the prior period's VAT (no notice if under KRW 500,000)

※ Deadlines on a weekend or holiday move to the next business day (Framework Act on National Taxes §5).
※ Not sure whether an item applies to you? Just ask on KakaoTalk, LINE or the Google Form.
